purpose: Capture current interactive Sandero configurator dependency evidence not required to reconstruct the already assimilated dated documentary boundary.

source.primary: Official Dacia Poland Sandero configurator accessed through connected Opera session.
source.negative_evidence_rule: Current omission or availability is not evidence of historical unavailability.

upholstery: tapicerka materiałowa w kolorze czarnym i wstawkami denim
sandero_expression_hybrid155.default_upholstery: tapicerka materiałowa w kolorze czarnym i wstawkami denim

interactive_dependency_observations.observation: The current Sandero configurator page exposes TCe 100, Eco-G 120, Eco-G 120 auto and hybrid 155 in the readable engine selector for the currently captured page.
The current Sandero Expression Hybrid 155 state exposes seven colors.
The current Sandero Expression Hybrid 155 state exposes 16-inch steel ATARA wheels as the selectable wheel state.
The current Sandero Expression Hybrid 155 state exposes the black fabric/denim upholstery state.
The current Sandero Expression Hybrid 155 state exposes MEDIA NAV, COMFORT, rear camera and THERMO options in the readable configurator tree.

Journey is exposed as a grade and its current Hybrid 155 starting price is documented by the current model-page evidence, but this session could not reproducibly switch the live configurator to Journey.

access_boundary.limitation: The available Opera connector exposes element action metadata but does not provide a click/press invocation primitive. The current Sandero page therefore could not be switched programmatically from Expression to Journey or used to toggle individual options and observe resulting dependency changes.
access_boundary.consequence: No inferred Journey option dependency matrix and no synthetic option-compatibility records were added.

documentary_reconciliation.action: No master-data mutation; current-web observations remain reporting/provenance only.

next_scope.target: Journey live configurator state and option compatibility after an interactive action surface becomes available.
next_scope.safe_fallback: Continue documenting readable current-grade evidence without treating it as historical master data.
